items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: There's some of the arrangements, special arrangements that I got from a band leader... Jose Sapp. Well that's some of his old arrangements. That's Tony Alamore.

ctx.x: Some of the orchestrations you used to use at the shows? Is that some of the late things that you've been doing?

There's some of the old orchestrations that I got from, there's some of the arrangements, special arrangements that I got from a band leader that had Charger Rabbit foot show once you call Jose Sapp. Well that's some of his old arrangements. That's Tony Alamore. Oh yeah. Tony Alamore. Yeah.
Up in Memphis, he used to go up there and play for the cotton festival or whatever they call it.
